requirement: Cached dashboard first meaningful paint p95 <= 2s on reference LAN hardware
Normal bounded chart preview p95 <= 3s on reference LAN hardware
Bounded pivot of 10,000 cells p95 <= 5s; test actual client memory
Long exports execute asynchronously with concurrency caps and cancellation
Server-side authorisation for every query, drill and export regardless of client access
Strict scope-specific cache keys; prohibit cache leakage across users
Encrypt stored artifacts and transport; expire shared files and access tokens
No arbitrary executable expressions, SQL, HTML or unapproved remote assets in chart spec
No false live status during WAN/server outages or stale caches
Immutable revisions and reproducible pinned data snapshots
Idempotent retry of render jobs and safe recovery after restart
No source-data mutation by Visualiser queries
WCAG 2.2 AA-oriented contrast, focus, keyboard operation and chart alternatives
Responsive views and accessible exported summaries
Typed versioned JSON schemas and compatibility matrix with target versions
Contract/visual regression tests across supported renderer versions
Trace query ID, source watermark, authorisation decision and server-side error classification
No direct PII or hidden sensitive filters in logs or telemetry
